title: Stellar black-hole companion: self-lensing
model_status: Known compact-object class, synthetic observing scenario; not an observed system.

source_papers.title: Masuda & Hotokezaka (2019), Prospects of Finding Detached Black Hole-Star Binaries with TESS
source_papers.used_for: Equations 1–7: ellipsoidal variation, beaming, Einstein radius and small-lens pulse height. Finite-source pulse shape independently integrated here.

source_papers.title: Sugiyama, Kurita & Takada (2020), On the wave optics effect on primordial black hole constraints from optical microlensing search
source_papers.used_for: Equations 3, 4, 6, 12–13: point lens, time trajectory, wave parameter and uniform finite-source average.

equations.small_lens_check: Peak excess approximately 2*(RE/Rstar)^2, before blending; not an exact finite-source expression

assumed_parameters_origin: Illustrative scenario choices, not measurements, posterior estimates, or universal class properties; exceptions identified in paper_constraints.
limitations: One illustrative geometry and parameter choice, not the population distribution or a prediction of discovery rate.
Gaussian noise is illustrative; stellar variability, blending variability, quality flags, gaps and extraction systematics are absent.
No identity, mass or primordial origin can be established from morphological similarity alone.
Circular orbit, uniform surface brightness, dark lens, negligible lens occultation radius.
Weak-distortion ellipsoidal approximation and assumed beaming coefficient; no passband atmosphere or accretion model.
RE uses orbital separation, rather than varying line-of-sight separation; valid near the narrow conjunction pulse.
Black holes and neutron stars exist; this folder is theoretical because this particular photometric scenario is simulated.

noise_free_curve.note: Display table thinned to roughly 12000 points; exposure integration used the full internal grid.

numerics.time_integration: Boxcar from cumulative trapezoidal integral; <= exposure/32 internal timestep
numerics.source_surface_brightness: Uniform disk for lensing; no limb darkening
numerics.noise: Independent Gaussian, fixed seed; not a realistic KBonus noise model
numerics.photometric_band: Achromatic geometric-lensing approximation; TZO is an uncalibrated relative-flux proxy

classification_limit: For proposing follow-up hypotheses only; neither a detection model nor validation. Similar ordinary objects and instrumental effects must be tested independently.
